$comment: Hand-curated list of 2024 U.S. House districts where one major party fielded no candidate. Identified by section-aware parsing of the Clerk PDF's per-state pages (data-pipeline/scripts/find_uncontested.py companion logic) plus manual verification.
source: U.S. House Clerk, Statistics of the Presidential and Congressional Election of November 5, 2024 — per-state recapitulation pages.

deferred_cases.reason: Sheila Cherfilus-McCormick (D) was re-elected without opposition; the Clerk PDF records no vote total for this district (footnote '(1)' instead of numbers). No turnover to add to the state total, no votes to replace. Imputing here would require estimating the district's House turnout from outside data.
